lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
teams-settings-team-folders: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
teams-settings-admin: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
All 5 pages load the same 2 files: 588,857 B raw, 158,127 B gzip, 99.3 % of the smallest page (teams-settings-personal, 593,268 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 423,477 B, @vue/runtime-core 61,517 B, dompurify 30,479 B, @vue/runtime-dom 25,488 B, @vue/reactivity 17,256 B.
1,708 B in 3 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (127 packages, 1,195 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
